behavior: `Select.List`, `Select.Popup` when it is the listbox, `Combobox.List` and `Autocomplete.List` take the accessible name of their control. In the order of AccName 1.2, the part uses `aria-labelledby` of the control, else its `aria-label`, else a native `Field.Label`. An `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` of the developer on the list, also a blank one, wins, and the part writes neither attribute. Base UI gives the listbox no name.
